title: Godot Cache issues: overwriting AI changes
author: SirUseful626
selftext:
Hi, I am using Codex with Godot 4.7 and it works really well, but very often (like 30% of the time) I run into cache problems - or at least I think they are.

When Godot is running, the AI cannot freely change the scripts or files, Godot is holding a cached version and frequently overwrites the changes the AI is doing. I have to close all open scenes and all scripts to get the AI to do changes that actually apply, sometimes I even have to close the whole engine for it to work. This of course becomes tedious to constantly close and open Godot. Anyone else running into this issue?

comments.author: Heliaxx
comments.body: Yea it happend in some cases. A bit annoying but for me it doesn't really happen all that often so it's manageable. Haven't found any other solution than to just close the engine.

comments.author: PlaidWorld
comments.body:
1. 99% of the time this is a non issue.   
2. keep your ide and godot project open and it can reload files when you click on it every once in a while.  
3. Im pretty sure you can get he AI to kill the cache if you ask it and make it aware. Many things with AI you just need to ask for. 

I have been coding non stop with 2 different AI for 6 months and like 4+ sessions all working in the same code base and this really has not been an issue. 

I allow all the agents to run back ground tests / headless tests also.
